# Growth

Make a monster grow by its kills or XP, not only by turns, and into one of several monsters by chance.

These go after `newmonster` or `selectmonster`, beside vanilla `growtime`, `growoffs` and `growterr`. The unit grows at the start of its player's turn, as with `growtime`, and only on `growterr`'s terrain when the monster has one. `copystats` and `clearspec` affect these.

<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = NO -->
A number outside its range, or a `growoffs` that names the monster itself or no monster, silently does nothing (logged in `coe5mod.log`).
<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = YES -->

!!! info "More in the CoE5 manual"
    Vanilla growth is in Illwinter's official modding manual, under ["Monster Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=14).

### growkills &lt;nbr&gt; <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #growkills .command data-toc-label="growkills" data-added="3.6" }

Like `growtime`, but the unit grows after this many kills since it last grew. With `growtime` or `growxp` too, it grows at whichever comes first.

- **nbr:** The kills, 1 or more. 0 takes it off.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@growkills 10
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    growkills 10
    ```

### growxp &lt;nbr&gt; <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #growxp .command data-toc-label="growxp" data-added="3.6" }

Like `growkills`, for XP. Every unit but a mindless one gains 1 XP each month and more in battle, so a mindless unit never grows by XP.

- **nbr:** The XP, 1 or more. 0 takes it off.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@growxp 20
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    growxp 20
    ```

### growoffs "&lt;monster&gt;" &lt;chance&gt; <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #growoffs .command data-toc-label="growoffs" data-added="3.6" }

Adds a monster the unit may grow into, with a chance out of 100 against the monster's other `growoffs` lines. A `growoffs` with no chance is vanilla's: it replaces the lines before it, and the unit always grows into that monster.

- **monster:** The monster in double quotes, as on [Monsters and Rituals by Name](monster-names.md#spawnoffs), or its offset.
- **chance:** 1 or more. The chances are weighted, so they need not add up to 100: 9 and 1 work like 90 and 10.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@growoffs "Uruk-hai" 90
    #!@growoffs "Olog-hai" 10
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    growoffs "Uruk-hai" 90
    growoffs "Olog-hai" 10
    ```

### Example growth { #example }

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newmonster "Uruk-hai"
    copystats "Heavy Infantry"
    copyspr "Goblin Hero"

    newmonster "Olog-hai"
    copystats "Rock Troll"
    copyspr "Rock Troll"

    newmonster "Orc of Mordor"
    copystats "Goblin Spearman"
    copyspr "Goblin Spearman"
    #!@growkills 5
    #!@growxp 30
    #!@growoffs "Uruk-hai" 90
    #!@growoffs "Olog-hai" 10
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newmonster "Uruk-hai"
    copystats "Heavy Infantry"
    copyspr "Goblin Hero"

    newmonster "Olog-hai"
    copystats "Rock Troll"
    copyspr "Rock Troll"

    newmonster "Orc of Mordor"
    copystats "Goblin Spearman"
    copyspr "Goblin Spearman"
    growkills 5
    growxp 30
    growoffs "Uruk-hai" 90
    growoffs "Olog-hai" 10
    ```
